zeus-1: In a group without a leader, I end up directing it.
zeus-2: I am comfortable telling people what to do.
hades-1: I keep my plans and opinions to myself unless asked.
hades-2: I prefer to work unseen and let results speak later.
hermes-1: I go out of my way to try unfamiliar places, ideas and methods.
hermes-2: I pick up new interests often and enjoy switching between them.
hestia-1: I keep the same routines, places and people for years and like it that way.
hestia-2: I would rather tend what I have than start something new.
apollo-1: I plan ahead and work to the plan.
apollo-2: Sloppy or unfinished work bothers me until it is put right.
dionysus-1: I act on the mood of the moment.
dionysus-2: I lose myself in music, company or sensation, and I want that often.
aphrodite-1: I adjust what I say so that the other person feels at ease.
aphrodite-2: I would rather give way than damage the mood.
ares-1: I say what I think even when it starts an argument.
ares-2: I enjoy competing and I play to win.
athena-1: Under pressure I stay calm and think clearly.
athena-2: Setbacks and insults leave me quickly.
poseidon-1: My moods are strong and other people can see them.
poseidon-2: When someone wrongs me, it stays with me for a long time.
hera-1: My commitments to family, partner or organisation come before my own plans.
hera-2: Disloyalty hurts me more than almost anything else.
artemis-1: I need long stretches entirely on my own terms.
artemis-2: I avoid arrangements that leave me owing or answerable to others.
demeter-1: I notice what the people around me need and look after it.
demeter-2: Helping someone grow is the most satisfying work I know.
hephaestus-1: I would rather build or fix something than attend a gathering.
hephaestus-2: I can work on an object or system for hours without noticing the time.
